result.body:
## Why

After !283 the SPI, I2C and GPIO peripherals existed in the SoC but only a Python caller could declare them (`SoCPipeline(peripherals=…)`); a graph, the API and the SDK could not, and no board knew where their pads go. The intern's ECG acquisition and any on-board proof need a graph that says "this SoC has an SPI ADC on these pins".

## What

- A graph JSON carries `peripherals: [{id, kind, params, irq_num?, pads?}]`; the mapper validates it (bounds, duplicate ids and IRQ lines, reserved and keyword ids, case-insensitive clashes) and appends the specs after the stream-derived FIFOs; `POST /graphs/create` and the SDK (sync and async) accept it; `POST /soc/generate` carries it into the build; an invalid declaration is a 422 naming the field.
- Board pads: a `PadBinding` names a platform resource or a Pmod connector; the composer wires SDA as one tristate (open-drain compatible), SCL push-pull, GPIO as per-pin tristates, and emits the constraints (Pmod I2C on Xilinx gets weak internal pull-ups; external ones remain required). Unknown resource, taken pin, wrong width, an id that names a board resource without binding it, a peripheral id that shadows a SoC block (`uart`, `timer0`, `sim_trace`, …): every case is refused by name, never tied off.
- `pads.iostandard` is restricted to `^[A-Z0-9_]{2,32}$` (an injection into the XDC was possible through the API, fork and import).
- The editor's save keeps a graph's peripherals; `examples/graph_declared_peripherals.py` runs the graph-declared SPI ADC and GPIO under Verilator against the bench models and builds the same configuration for the Arty A7.

## Proof

- New tests fail on develop (32 failed / 26 passed on the pre-fix tree) and pass here: graph validation 16, board pads 17, peripheral ids 24, API generate 8 (+3), SDK 634, editor round trip.
- Vivado 2024.2 `synth_design` on the Arty: the three peripherals add 317 LUT, 359 FF, 16 IOB.
- Regression: six artefacts byte-identical to develop (ROM and streamed `firmware.bin`, bare SoC, example ROM and streamed `sim.v`, the three-peripheral SoC).
- Independently re-verified three times (injection and shadowing probes replayed on every path).

## Not in this MR

A stream naming a peripheral as its source (`source: "spi0"`) is the next slice (S2). Pull-ups are emitted for Xilinx only.
